leaves.name: modularHTPrinted
leaves.doc: R13, printed existence form, reading-robust (htnew-print): for a prime l, embeddings iota_C, iota_L and a Tau Ceti newform f of weight k >= 2 and level N (every level, l | N included), there is a continuous rho : G_Q -> GL_2(Qbar_l), unramified outside N l, with either (arithmetic Frobenius trace a_p and Hodge-Tate weights {0, 1-k}) or (geometric Frobenius trace a_p and Hodge-Tate weights {0, k-1}) (kernel convention: cyclotomic weight -1). No semisimplicity asked; the trace clause is 'if iota_C(alpha) = a_p then tr = iota_L(alpha)'. Replaces eigenformHTNew: semisimplification preserves HT weights, the dual, the newform dictionary and the Chebotarev/Brauer-Nesbitt transport are proved in Lean (EigenformHTPrinted.lean).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (existence form of the theorem on Galois representations attached to newforms, Hodge-Tate weights 0, k-1 at l, every level; the reading points of ht-exists are absorbed by the statement: normalization and sign convention by or-introduction, no semisimplicity, trace clause only); locator UNVERIFIED
